target_module: systolic_pe (a leaf PE instantiated 9x inside the top module systolic_array_gemm -- a shared, deeply-reused submodule, not the top itself)
trigger_description: a_in[7:0] (the incoming activation operand's low byte) equals 8'hA5 (165) AND b_in[0] (the incoming weight operand's LSB) is 1 AND en is asserted. A rare AND combination of several existing operand/enable bits, P ~= 2^-9 per active cycle, never reached by the golden testbench's small (-9..100) operand range.
observable_effect: The affected PE's c_out accumulator -- and therefore the corresponding element of the top-level c_mat_out bus -- is offset by +4096 relative to the correct matrix-multiply accumulation in that cycle. No other element and no other cycle is affected.
expected_value_if_clean: c_mat_out element equals the exact golden matrix-multiply accumulation with no offset.
expected_value_if_infected: c_mat_out element equals the golden accumulation plus 4096.
